newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends slightly softer.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends slightly softer.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed softer at C$1.3676 (US0.7312) on Friday from Thursday's close at C$1.3665 (US$0.7318) in heavy year-end trading, dealers said. * Market players in the United States showed strong interest to buy U.S. dollars to the detriment of the Canadian currency, dealers said.

In economic news Friday, Statistics Canada said that wholesale trade rose 1.7 percent seasonally adjusted in October to C$21.94 billion. A Reuter survey of economists had forecast a 0.3 percent month-on-month rise in October.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar eased to 1.1340 marks from Thursday's close of 1.1393 marks, but rose to 83.49 yen from 83.38 yen.
